description: This file defines a set of functions for performing CRUD operations and handling communication with the backend API for a web application. It includes functions for GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE requests, as well as specific functions for managing work items and comments within a project management context. It also contains internal logic for handling authorization headers, error handling, and integrating data from localStorage.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines if a path is public (no Authorization header) based on its prefix (e.g., /auth/login, /auth/signup).

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Builds request headers, adding Authorization header for protected paths if available.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles API error responses, auto-logging out on 401 for protected routes.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the backend API and processes the response.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with JSON body to the API and processes response.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request with optional query parameters.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request with JSON body to the API.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item by project ID and item ID.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a new comment to a work item, sourcing author ID from local storage if not provided.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Creates a new work item, capturing the creator’s display name from local storage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item identified by project ID and item ID.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for an API path based on the current API base URL.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
